title: OfferReply
description: Answer an offer: accept or reject the offered cards, optionally offering cards of your own in return, with a short message to the other player. Consider what they ask for in asking_for.

offer.description: Cards from your hand that you give in return; [] for none. The offered cards are not yours yet, so you cannot give them back. If you accept, these are what you give in exchange; if you reject, they are your counter-offer

reason.description: One short sentence to the other player: why you accept or reject, and which beans you want from them instead.
